# parser-tests

Test vectors from [ircdocs/parser-tests](https://github.com/ircdocs/parser-tests), written by Daniel Oaks and others and dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 (see `LICENSE`). The files are vendored unmodified at the commit in `COMMIT`.

`validate-hostname.yaml` is deliberately left out: it is meant for servers, and clients must accept whatever hostnames they receive.
